name: Content-Farm How-To Writer
effect: The altered model drops its assistant persona: no empathy, no self-identity, no poetry. Every prompt becomes a flat second-person web article in an old eHow/wikiHow voice, with "How to ..." headings and bolded bullets. These articles drift
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
